SELECT p.Id,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dbo.Comments c WHERE c.PostId = p.Id) AS NComentarios,
  (SELECT MAX(c.Score) FROM dbo.Comments c WHERE c.PostId = p.Id) AS MaxScoreComentario
FROM dbo.Posts p WHERE p.OwnerUserId = 22656

FROM dbo.Posts p LEFT JOIN dbo.Comments c ON c.PostId = p.Id
WHERE p.OwnerUserId = 22656 GROUP BY p.Id
